units.title: American Sign Language, Level I

topics.title: Communication. The student communicates in ASL using expressive and receptive communication skills without voice. The student is expected to:

subtopics.title: Communication. The student communicates in ASL using expressive and receptive communication skills without voice. The student is expected to:

outcomes.text: engage in a variety of ASL exchanges of learned material to socialize and to provide and obtain information;
demonstrate an understanding of basic ASL such as simple stories, everyday commands, and brief instructions when dealing with familiar topics;

topics.title: Cultures. The student gains knowledge and understanding of American Deaf culture. The student is expected to:

subtopics.title: Cultures. The student gains knowledge and understanding of American Deaf culture. The student is expected to:

outcomes.text: recognize and use Deaf cultural norms to demonstrate an understanding of the perspectives of American Deaf culture;

topics.title: Communities. The student participates in the Deaf/ASL community by using ASL. The student is expected to:
